name: Schema-Based Aliasing System

style.code_comments: explain schema aliasing and industry mappings only

say: Use schema-based aliasing to enable industry-specific terminology (guest, hotel) in prompts while maintaining global parameters (customer, company) across industries. Map provider data to Global Variables first, then apply schema aliasing for industry-specific terminology.
instructions: Define schemas per industry with alias mappings (e.g., hotel: customer=guest, company=hotel).
Map provider data to Global Variables first: {{CLOUDBEDS.guestPhone}} → {{customer.phone}} → {{customer.guest.phone}}.
Then apply schema aliasing: {{customer.guest.phone}} → {{guest.phone}} (via schema alias).
Use industry-specific terminology in prompts ({{guest.*}}, {{hotel.*}}) while maintaining global parameters internally.
Maintain global parameters ({{customer.*}}, {{company.*}}) for cross-industry compatibility.
Reservation data is tied to customer record: {{customer.reservation.*}} (not {{reservation.*}} standalone).
Property data is tied to company: {{company.property.*}} (not {{property.*}} standalone).

usage_examples.prompt_with_alias: You are assisting {{guest.firstName}} with their reservation {{guest.reservation.id}} at {{hotel.name}}.

global_parameters.description: Global parameters work across all industries - these are the standard namespaces

reservation.description: Reservation data is tied to customer record - use {{customer.reservation.*}}
reservation.note: Reservation data must be tied to customer record for session-scoped access across assistants

property.description: Property data is tied to company - use {{company.property.*}}
property.note: Property data must be tied to company for consistency across industries

cloudbeds.description: Cloudbeds provider data mapping with schema aliasing

mapping_workflow.step_1: Fetch provider data (Cloudbeds API returns guest/reservation data)
mapping_workflow.step_4: Apply schema aliasing (if hotel industry): {{customer.guest.phone}} → {{guest.phone}} (via alias)
mapping_workflow.step_5: Use in prompts: Can use industry-specific terminology ({{guest.*}}, {{hotel.*}}) or global parameters ({{customer.*}}, {{company.*}})

best_practices: Always map provider data to Global Variables first, then apply schema aliasing
Use industry-specific terminology in prompts ({{guest.*}}, {{hotel.*}}) for better UX
Maintain global parameters ({{customer.*}}, {{company.*}}) internally for cross-industry compatibility
Tie reservation data to customer record: {{customer.reservation.*}} (not standalone {{reservation.*}})
Tie property data to company: {{company.property.*}} (not standalone {{property.*}})
Define schemas per industry with clear alias mappings
